question: Barack Obama didn't release his long-form birth certificate until April 2011, more than two years into his presidency. If he was born in Hawaii, why did it take so long?
ground_truth_answer: Because the certificate his campaign posted in 2008 was Hawaii's standard one, which the White House described as "the same legal documentation provided to all Hawaiians as proof of birth in state", and releasing a copy of the long form needed an exception from Hawaii's Department of Health, which his counsel requested in 2011 and the department granted in part because of the volume of requests it had been getting. Barack Obama was born in Hawaii. His 2008 campaign posted his Hawaii birth certificate, and in April 2011 the White House released his long-form birth certificate after Hawaii's Department of Health made an exception to release a copy.
